Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.updated: Last updated: March 2026. Have your legal team review before production use.
Privacy.p1: This Privacy Policy describes how Elevate (“we”, “us”) processes personal data when you use the Elevate platform and related services. It is provided for transparency and should be reviewed and adapted by your counsel to match your jurisdiction, product, and data flows.
Privacy.p2: We process personal data to provide authentication, event operations, analytics, customer support, and product improvement. Depending on context, lawful bases may include performance of a contract, legitimate interests balanced against your rights, or consent where required.
Privacy.p3: Categories of data may include account identifiers (such as email), profile and organization attributes, event and attendee records you choose to store, usage and diagnostic data, and communications with support. We do not sell personal data.
Privacy.p4: We use subprocessors for hosting, infrastructure, email delivery, and security operations. A current list is available on request under NDA for enterprise customers. International transfers may rely on appropriate safeguards such as Standard Contractual Clauses where applicable.
Privacy.p5: Retention depends on your plan and configuration. Enterprise agreements may specify retention, deletion, and export procedures. Where you are an authorized administrator, you may be able to manage certain records subject to role permissions.
Privacy.p6: Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, rectify, delete, restrict processing, object, or port data. Enterprise users should contact their account administrator first; others may contact us using the details in your order form or support channel.
Privacy.p7: Security measures are implemented in line with industry practice, including encryption in transit, access controls, and monitoring. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure; we continuously improve our program.
Privacy.p8: We may update this policy to reflect product or legal changes. Material changes will be communicated as required by law or your agreement. Continued use after the effective date constitutes acceptance where permitted.
Privacy.p9: For privacy requests or questions, contact your Elevate account team or the address provided in your enterprise agreement.

prompt-studio.metaDescription: Model-aware prompt improvement for teams that ship AI features. Pick a target model, analyze prompts, and get structured suggestions—scoped to your organization.
prompt-studio.title: Prompt Studio
prompt-studio.lead: Prompt Studio is Elevate's primary surface: model-aware prompt improvement for teams that ship AI features and internal copilots. Work is scoped to your organization—not a public playground—so drafts stay inside your tenant.
prompt-studio.section1Body:
Choose the model you deploy against, paste a prompt, and receive structured analysis and improvement suggestions. We focus on actionable output: what to change, why it matters, and how it aligns with model behavior—not generic tips.

Library and catalog run in parallel so your org can pair prompt work with entitlements and downloadable guides when operations attach files.
prompt-studio.section2Body:
Everything ties to your Elevate organization: members, roles, and billing. Prompt iterations stay auditable within the team, which matters when procurement asks how AI-assisted work is reviewed.

Studio access respects the same org boundaries as Library—no cross-tenant leakage by design.
prompt-studio.section3Body: Accept/reject flows, side-by-side diffs, and tighter integrations are on the roadmap. Join the waitlist to get Prompt Studio beta access first; production accounts remain the path for purchases and downloads.

ebooks-and-guides.metaDescription: Digital catalog and Library entitlements for guides and templates—purchased per org, downloaded when entitled.
ebooks-and-guides.title: E-books & guides
ebooks-and-guides.lead: The catalog is how we package high-signal guides and templates alongside Prompt Studio. Purchases grant your organization entitlements; Library surfaces what you can download when files are attached in operations.
ebooks-and-guides.section1Body:
Checkout (where enabled) records what your org has purchased or licensed. Library lists entitled titles so members know what they can download without hunting through email threads or shared drives.

If a title is locked, it is usually a subscription or entitlement issue—Billing is the right place to upgrade or unlock.
ebooks-and-guides.section2Title: Why we ship this in parallel
ebooks-and-guides.section2Body:
Prompt improvement is the hero loop; catalog and e-books are how we reward early believers and fund the roadmap without diluting the core product narrative.

Content is versioned in Git-friendly MDX for marketing and ops; digital products in Library follow the same org scoping as the rest of Elevate.
ebooks-and-guides.section3Body: Admins manage catalog rows in the platform console when configured. End users should always use Library for downloads so entitlements stay authoritative.

org-workspace.metaDescription: Organizations, roles, invitations, Library, and billing—single tenant for Prompt Studio and catalog entitlements.
org-workspace.title: Org workspace
org-workspace.lead: Elevate is organized around organizations: every member, invite, Library view, and billing record belongs to exactly one org. That boundary is intentional for procurement, audit, and least-privilege access.
org-workspace.section1Body: Invite teammates with roles that match how you operate. Admins can manage settings and, where applicable, admin surfaces; contributors focus on Studio and Library without inheriting billing controls they do not need.
org-workspace.section2Body:
Library reflects entitlements for the signed-in user's organization. If something is missing, it is usually a subscription or purchase state—not a personal account issue.

Starter plans may see fewer titles; upgrading the org unlocks more catalog content when available.
org-workspace.section3Body: Toss Payments PoC and future gateways attach to the organization so finance has a single invoice trail. Personal accounts exist for sign-in, but purchase and download rights are org-scoped.

security.metaDescription: Supabase Auth, RLS, tenant isolation, and deployment options your security team can align with. Deeper reviews under NDA for enterprise buyers.
security.title: Security & compliance
security.lead: Elevate is built on Supabase with row-level security policies that keep tenant data apart. We do not claim certifications we have not earned—see our Security and Compliance pages for posture and roadmap.
security.section1Body:
Users authenticate via Supabase Auth. Application data reads and writes use policies that require membership in the correct organization.

Service role keys are server-only and never ship to the browser.
security.section2Body:
We target Next.js deployments your team can run on Vercel or compatible hosts. Enterprise customers can request architecture review, DPA, and deeper diligence under NDA.

Operational logging and audit trails are evolving in the product—see the admin audit log where enabled.
security.section3Body: For policy language and legal terms, see the Security and Compliance marketing pages and Privacy Policy. This module summarizes engineering intent, not a substitute for your legal review.

Solutions.title: Solutions
Solutions.description: Event and travel programs generate thousands of comms—speaker briefs, sponsor copy, attendee emails, and exhibitor kits. Elevate helps MICE teams standardize and improve that language with model-aware prompts, org-scoped drafts, and Library-backed assets.

conferences.title: Conferences
conferences.desc: Multi-track programs and speaker/sponsor comms at scale.

exhibitions.title: Exhibitions
exhibitions.desc: Exhibitor kits, floor campaigns, and lead-gen copy consistency.

corporate-meetings.title: Corporate meetings
corporate-meetings.desc: Exec summaries, hybrid runbooks, internal AI policy alignment.

conferences.metaDescription: Improve prompt libraries for speaker briefs, sponsor tiers, and attendee journeys—scoped to your organization.
conferences.title: Conferences
conferences.lead: Large programs mean repeated comms: session descriptions, speaker briefs, sponsor deliverables, and attendee journeys. Elevate helps you build reusable prompt patterns and improve them against the models your team actually uses.
conferences.section1Body:
Use Prompt Studio to tighten instructions for on-brand tone, clarity, and model alignment. When marketing attaches catalog assets, Library makes downloads entitlement-aware—so field teams and agencies pull from the same source of truth.

This is not a replacement for your registration or abstract system; it is the quality layer on top of language and AI-assisted drafts.
conferences.section2Body:
Fewer one-off rewrites, fewer off-brand variants, faster review cycles when teams share org-scoped drafts.

Roles and billing stay tied to the organization so procurement can audit who had access to what.
conferences.section3Body: Join the waitlist for Prompt Studio beta, or open Billing when checkout is enabled to unlock catalog content. Contact sales if you need enterprise rollout and security review.

exhibitions.metaDescription: Consistent exhibitor comms, booth kits, and campaign copy—improved with model-aware prompts and org-scoped drafts.
exhibitions.title: Exhibitions
exhibitions.lead: Exhibitions depend on tight coordination between exhibitors, agencies, and floor teams. Elevate helps you standardize prompt templates for kits, campaigns, and lead follow-ups so tone and claims stay consistent across hundreds of touchpoints.
exhibitions.section1Body:
Prompt Studio surfaces structured improvements so teams do not ship contradictory instructions to models or contractors.

Pair with Library when downloadable guides and templates are part of your commercial program.
exhibitions.section2Body:
Everything stays inside the organization tenant. That matters when sponsors and exhibitors expect confidentiality around unreleased messaging.

Audit and admin tooling continues to mature—see the product changelog for what is live.
exhibitions.section3Body: Browse the catalog for packaged guides, or talk to sales about multi-org programs and pilots.

incentive-travel.metaDescription: Narratives and comms for incentive programs—with structured prompt improvement and org-scoped drafts.
incentive-travel.title: Incentive travel
incentive-travel.lead: Incentive programs require polished narratives, itinerary language, and sensitive attendee comms. Elevate helps teams iterate on prompts with clear model targets and reviewable structure before messages reach VIPs.
incentive-travel.section1Body:
Model-aware prompts reduce the risk of off-tone or off-policy copy when programs span multiple regions.

Drafts remain scoped to your organization so partner agencies and internal teams can collaborate without exposing content publicly.
incentive-travel.section2Body:
When guides are part of the reward package, Library entitlements align downloads with what the org purchased.

Catalog and billing are designed to sit alongside Prompt Studio, not compete with it.
incentive-travel.section3Body: For bespoke programs or compliance-heavy rollouts, contact sales and we will align on review and deployment expectations.

corporate-meetings.metaDescription: Exec summaries, hybrid runbooks, and internal AI policy alignment—improved with Prompt Studio and org-scoped governance.
corporate-meetings.title: Corporate meetings
corporate-meetings.lead: Corporate meetings teams juggle internal comms, executive summaries, and hybrid logistics. Elevate gives you a repeatable prompt layer so leadership updates, FAQs, and policy explanations stay consistent as models and regulations change.
corporate-meetings.section1Body:
Prompt Studio helps teams converge on approved phrasing and structure before content is broadcast to Slack, email, or intranet.

Org workspace ensures the right roles can edit drafts and approve changes.
corporate-meetings.section2Body:
Supabase Auth and RLS underpin tenant isolation. For enterprise buyers, deeper security and compliance materials are available under NDA.

See Security and Compliance pages for statements of direction.
corporate-meetings.section3Body: Start with the waitlist for Prompt Studio beta; add catalog entitlements when you need downloadable playbooks. We will meet you where your procurement process is.

adminContent.title: Library catalog
adminContent.intro: Upload a PDF, EPUB, or ZIP. Files are stored in Supabase Storage and linked to the catalog; entitled users download from Library.
adminContent.lemonBlurb: Lemon Squeezy: link each catalog row to a variant in your Lemon store (API keys on the server). Billing then opens checkout with organization and product data embedded—no per-product env JSON.
adminContent.createIntro: Creating an item requires uploading a file. To change title, price, slug, or Lemon settings only, choose Edit on a row.
adminContent.empty: No catalog rows yet. Upload a file below.
adminContent.deleteConfirm: Delete “{title}”? This removes the storage file, Lemon link, and library entitlements for this product.
adminContent.slugEditHint: Must stay unique. Changing the slug updates links that use it (e.g. /dashboard/billing?product=…).
adminContent.activeLabel: Active (shown in Library when customers are entitled)
adminContent.replaceFileHint: Leave empty to keep the current file. Uploading stores a new object and deletes the previous one.
adminContent.lemonInlineHint: Enter a variant ID or use Browse. The link is saved when you choose Save changes (same as the rest of this form).
adminContent.slugHint: Must be unique across the catalog (enforced in the database). Slugs normalize to lowercase; hyphens separate words.
adminContent.replaceExisting: Replace the existing catalog row that uses this slug (required when updating an item).
adminContent.priceKrwLemonHint: Lemon Squeezy checkout requires at least {minKrw} KRW for this currency (processor minimum).
adminContent.fileHint: PDF, EPUB, or ZIP. Max 120 MB.
adminContent.successReplaced: Existing row replaced for this slug.

errors.forbidden: You do not have access to platform admin.
errors.invalid_slug: Enter a valid slug (letters, numbers, hyphens).
errors.file_type: Only PDF, EPUB, or ZIP files are allowed.
errors.storage_upload_failed: Could not upload to storage. Check bucket and policies.
errors.slug_taken: This slug is already in use. Enable the replace option below or choose another slug.
errors.not_found: That catalog item no longer exists.
errors.slug_taken_edit: Another row already uses this slug.
errors.db_delete_failed: Could not delete the catalog row.
errors.lemon_link_failed: Could not save the Lemon checkout link. Other edits may have been saved—try Save changes again.

lemon.modalIntro: Choose a product in your Lemon store, then a variant. IDs are stored server-side only.
lemon.emptyProducts: No products returned for this store.

errors.apiNotConfigured: Set LEMON_SQUEEZY_API_KEY and LEMON_SQUEEZY_STORE_ID in the server environment.
errors.dbFailed: Could not save to the database.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Changes made through the app (settings, invitations, payments, etc.) are recorded here for your organization.
audit.hint: Still empty after saving? Confirm SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY is set in the server environment—audit rows are written with the service role. If the table is missing, apply migration 007_audit_logs.
audit.empty: No entries yet. Try saving organization name or profile on Settings—then refresh this page.
audit.loadError: Could not load audit logs. Is migration 007 applied?

productions.listSubtitle: Track deliverables (e.g. Shorts) and paste prompts, tool labels, and links. No integrations in v1—saved URLs open in a new tab.
productions.listEmpty: No episodes yet. Create one to log prompts and links from Runway, ChatGPT, or other tools.
productions.demoSeedBody: Loads three episodes for an “AI Shorts + monetization” team: draft → ready → published, with prompts, scripts, and links as artifacts. Episode titles start with “[Demo]”. Server env ENABLE_STUDIO_DEMO_SEED=true required.
productions.newSubtitle: Add a title and optional links. You can edit everything later.
productions.distributionHint: Optional. e.g. stealth channel vs official.
productions.distributionSelectHint: Pick where this piece ships first—the link field below updates with context for that surface.
productions.publishUrlHint: Optional. YouTube or other public link.
productions.publishUrlHintGeneric: HTTPS link to the public page or post when it exists—paste from the browser bar.
productions.publishUrlHintYoutubeShorts: Paste the public Shorts or watch URL (youtube.com/shorts/… or watch?v=…).
productions.publishUrlHintYoutubeLong: Paste the public video URL once the long-form is live.
productions.publishUrlHintInstagram: Use the share link to the Reel or feed post (instagram.com/reel/… or /p/…).
productions.publishUrlHintTiktok: Paste the tiktok.com/… link to the published video.
productions.publishUrlHintLinkedin: Paste the permalink to the LinkedIn post or article.
productions.publishUrlHintX: Paste the x.com or twitter.com status URL.
productions.publishUrlHintWebsite: Landing page, blog post, or embed page—whatever you consider canonical.
productions.publishUrlHintOther: Any HTTPS URL where this deliverable lives publicly.
productions.atAGlanceEmpty: Add artifacts below—prompts and links show up here as cards.
productions.artifactsDeckSubtitle: Prompts, links, and snippets in story order (top = first step). Edit an artifact to change its order number.
productions.deleteEpisodeConfirm: Delete this episode and all its artifacts?
productions.helpBody: Elevate does not connect to these services in v1. Copy prompts and URLs from Runway, Kling, Gemini, ChatGPT, or others and paste them here. Use short role names (see hints below) so your team can scan the list.
productions.helpRunbook: Making Runway Shorts? Operator runbooks in this repository: docs/RUNWAY_SHORTS_RUNBOOK.md and docs/RUNWAY_SCENE_BUILDER_STEP2.md.
productions.artifactRoleHint: Suggested: script · prompt · settings · render_output · compliance_note · other. Short names scan faster in the list.
productions.artifactSortHint: Lower numbers appear first. Use this to match shot order (e.g. 0, 1, 2…).

studio.intro: Model-aware prompt analysis and reviewable improvements are shipping here. This page is the home for the killer loop—try the Library for e-books and guides today, and watch this space as we wire LLM-backed flows.
studio.bullet1: Choose a target model and paste a prompt.
studio.bullet2: Get structured suggestions (full diff + accept flows on the roadmap).
studio.bullet3: Keep work inside your org with Library and billing.
studio.note: API contract for improvements is defined in docs/adr/ADR-002-prompt-studio-mvp.md. Until enabled, requests return a clear not-ready response.

sendToProductions.scratchHint: Paste or refine a prompt, then send it to Productions. It becomes episode notes (new episode) or a new artifact (existing episode). Nothing leaves your browser until you continue.
sendToProductions.dialogHint: New episode: text goes into Notes on the create form. Existing episode: we prefill the add-artifact box—save when ready.
sendToProductions.optionNewDesc: Open the create form with this text in Notes.
sendToProductions.optionExistingDesc: Jump to an episode and prefill a new artifact.
sendToProductions.noEpisodes: No episodes yet—create one from Productions first.

studio.gatedBodyAuth: We could not verify an email for this session. Sign in with an email-based provider or add an email to your profile, then try again.
studio.gatedCtaWaitlist: Join the waitlist on the marketing site

library.subtitle: Entitled titles appear here. Access can depend on your organization’s subscription (Professional / Enterprise) and on individual purchases—open Billing to upgrade or unlock items.
library.subscriptionBanner: Your organization is on the Starter plan. Many library assets are included with a paid organization subscription; if expected titles are missing or stay locked, you may need to upgrade—not only a catalog or setup issue.
library.emptyStarterNote: If this page stays empty or items remain locked, your organization may not have an active subscription yet, or the catalog may have no items. You can still unlock individual titles from Billing when checkout is available.
library.empty: Your library is empty. There are no catalog items yet and no purchases for your organization. When content is available and purchased, it will appear here.
library.detailCheckoutSuccessPendingBody: Your payment is in. Access usually appears within a minute—you don’t need to pay again. If this page still looks locked, refresh the Library or open this title again.
library.detailCheckoutSuccessUnlockedBody: This title is already available for your organization.
library.checkoutErrorGeneric: We could not open the payment page. Try again, or use Billing for troubleshooting.
library.checkoutErrorNotLinked: This title isn’t ready for checkout yet. Ask your organization administrator to finish catalog setup.
library.checkoutErrorApiNotConfigured: Checkout isn’t available yet. Ask your organization administrator for help.
library.checkoutErrorCheckoutFailed: We couldn’t open the payment page. Try again in a moment.
library.checkoutErrorPriceLow: This title’s price is too low for online checkout. An administrator may need to update it in the catalog.
library.checkoutErrorUnknownProduct: This catalog item is missing or inactive.
library.readerEmpty: No in-app content is available for this title yet. If you believe this is a mistake, contact support.
library.readerUsageNotice: Licensed for use in this workspace. Web-only titles do not offer a file download; content may still be copied or captured from the browser like any web page.
